title: 💠 **The fire from the explosions of non-compliant oil tankers lit up the night sky over the Strait of Hormuz**
text:
💠 **The fire from the explosions of non-compliant oil tankers lit up the night sky over the Strait of Hormuz**"

"**Public Relations of the IRGC Navy:**"

"🔹 From the early hours of today until now, three non-compliant oil tankers on an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz have suffered explosions and intense fires, to the extent that fishermen in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz experienced a bright night."

"🔹 These oil tankers exploded after striking a naval mine because they had switched off their navigation and identification systems and were passing through unauthorized routes in the Strait of Hormuz. They have been abandoned on the southern shores of the Strait of Hormuz and are burning."

"🔹 The IRGC Navy announces: Iran’s regulations for the Strait of Hormuz have repeatedly been announced to all ships through radio stations and IRGC Navy notices. Any defiance or disregard of these regulations by vessels, and any accompanying of the aggressive U.S. military in passing through unauthorized routes in the Strait of Hormuz, will be accompanied by incidents such as these."

"🔹 The reality of the situation in the Strait of Hormuz is what you can see, not what the terrorist commander of CENTCOM announces on social media using archived images.
